description: Reads a site's Referrer-Policy header and its <meta name=referrer> tag from the home page, works out the policy a browser would apply, and rates how much of the URL it sends to other sites (strict, moderate or leaky). One GET; links on other pages can set their own policy. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_referrer_policy_audit
title: Security Referrer Policy Audit
